board-canvass: Final Canvass of Results, General Election of November 5, 2024 (the State Canvassing Board's meeting book of November 26, 2024)
sos-precincts: 2024 General Election, precinct-level results (one workbook per county)

notes: Certified by the State Canvassing Board on 2024-11-26; listed on https://www.sos.alabama.gov/alabama-votes/voter/election-information/2024. A scanned meeting book: only each table's Total row is read from its text layer, and only when it reads as well-formed numbers. The Total rows the text layer misreads or leaves out (11 contests) and the last two pages (Statewide Amendment 1 and the 20 local amendments' county figures) were read by eye from the page pictures and typed into the loader, used only while this file's SHA-256 is the one read (88ec1f92e29aca3a715981f8540fad2351e8dfde8bc252022821ce108efad49d). These figures are a control only: the votes stored are the county workbooks'.

Alabama Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Elections Data' page (https://www.sos.alabama.gov/alabama-votes/voter/election-data): one workbook per county, every contest on its ballot by precinct, with the county's absentee and provisional columns. The results the counties certified; for every contest the State Canvassing Board also certifies, each county's sums are compared with the Board's canvass (checks named 'al: ...').
gaps: 139 contests: how many were to be elected

The county workbooks do not print how many each voter could choose, and for these contests no precinct wholly inside the contest shows it in its votes, over votes and under votes (many are constables). They are stored with no seat count and no winner. First: Member, County Commission, District 5 (Autauga County); Member, County Commission, District 2 (Barbour County); Constable, Precinct 4 (Barbour County); Constable, Precinct 7 (Barbour County); Member, County Commission, District 1 (Bibb County).
